theorem p1FifthCorrectionKernel_eq_cell_indicators (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData)
    (hab : D.a ≤ D.b) (t : Fin 5 → ℝ) :
    D.p1FifthCorrectionKernel t =
      ∑ j ∈ D.cells5, (D.p1FifthJointCell j).indicator (D.p1FifthCellProfile j) t := by
  by_cases ht : t ∈ D.p1FifthJointUnion
  · obtain ⟨j, hj, htj⟩ : ∃ j ∈ D.cells5, t ∈ D.p1FifthJointCell j := by
      obtain ⟨j, hrest⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp ht
      obtain ⟨hj, htj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hrest
      exact ⟨j, hj, htj⟩
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem j hj]
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem htj]
      exact D.p1FifthCorrectionKernel_on_jointCell hab j hj t htj

def primeOwnCubeIcoIntegral {k r : ℕ} (a b lambda : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (j : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (m + 1))
    (L : Fin r → (Fin (k + 1) → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (c : Fin r → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ t in logPrimeMeshCell a b m j ∩
      primeAffineGateRegion (primeOwnCubeGateForms L) (primeOwnCubeGateBounds lambda c),
    primeTupleMinusProfile lambda t * ∏ i, 1 / t i

def primeOwnCubeGatedProfile {k : ℕ} (lambda : ℝ) (t : Fin (k + 1) → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if primeTupleOwnCubeForm t < lambda then primeTupleMinusProfile lambda t else 0

/-- The literal difference of two real Ico-cell integrals. -/
def fifthCellIntegral (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData)
    (j : Fin 5 → Fin (D.m + 1)) : ℝ :=
  primeOwnCubeIcoIntegral (D.a : ℝ) (D.b : ℝ) (D.cap5 j : ℝ) D.m j
      ordinaryUpperFiveGateForms (D.fifthParentGateBounds j) -
    primeOwnCubeIcoIntegral (D.a : ℝ) (D.b : ℝ) (D.old5 j : ℝ) D.m j
      ordinaryUpperFiveGateForms (D.fifthParentGateBounds j)

def fifthCorrectionIntegral (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j ∈ D.cells5, D.fifthCellIntegral j
